context_manifest.content:
# Issue link import

parse_issue_url is a pure parser; it never follows a link. Inputs are URL
strings without control characters. The supported hosts are exactly
forge.example.test and code.example.test, using http or https. Supported paths
are /OWNER/REPOSITORY/issues/NUMBER with either no trailing slash or exactly one
trailing slash. OWNER and REPOSITORY are nonempty single path components;
NUMBER contains ASCII digits only. Preserve the number as a string, including
leading zeroes. Return (tracker_base_url, number), where tracker_base_url ends
in /issues without a trailing slash. Ignore a query string and fragment.

Unsupported hosts, schemes and path shapes return None, not a partial match.
Multiple trailing slashes, missing/non-numeric ids and suffixes such as /comments
are not supported. This is not a browser, URL security filter or network client.
Both spellings of a supported issue link must continue to import successfully.
